import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bubble_sort_precond (v : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- One bubble pass, scanning from the right: adjacent elements are compared and
swapped when out of order, so the minimum ends up at the head. -/
def passMin : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | x :: t =>
    match passMin t with
    | [] => [x]
    | y :: t' => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: t' else y :: x :: t'

/-- Repeat bubble passes: each pass fixes one more element at the front. The
`Nat` argument is the number of remaining passes (at least the list length). -/
def bubbleSortAux : Nat → List Int → List Int
  | 0, l => l
  | n + 1, l =>
    match passMin l with
    | [] => []
    | y :: t => y :: bubbleSortAux n t
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def bubble_sort (v : List Int) (h_precond : bubble_sort_precond v) : List Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  bubbleSortAux v.length v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bubble_sort_postcond (v : List Int) (result : List Int) (h_precond : bubble_sort_precond v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) result ∧ result.Perm v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem passMin_perm (l : List Int) : (passMin l).Perm l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [passMin]
  | cons x t ih =>
    rw [passMin]
    split
    · rename_i heq
      rw [heq] at ih
      have ht : t = [] := List.nil_perm.mp ih
      subst ht
      simp
    · rename_i y t' heq
      rw [heq] at ih
      split
      · exact ih.cons x
      · exact (List.Perm.swap x y t').trans (ih.cons x)

theorem passMin_head_le (l : List Int) :
    ∀ y t', passMin l = y :: t' → ∀ z ∈ l, y ≤ z := by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro y t' h; simp [passMin] at h
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro y t' h
    rw [passMin] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hp
      have hnil := passMin_perm t
      rw [hp] at hnil
      have ht : t = [] := List.nil_perm.mp hnil
      subst ht
      simp at h
      intro z hz
      simp at hz
      omega
    · rename_i a t2 hp
      have hle : ∀ z ∈ t, a ≤ z := ih a t2 hp
      by_cases hxa : x ≤ a
      · rw [if_pos hxa] at h
        have hy : y = x := by injection h with h1 h2; omega
        subst hy
        intro z hz
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with hz | hz
        · omega
        · exact le_trans hxa (hle z hz)
      · rw [if_neg hxa] at h
        have hy : y = a := by injection h with h1 h2; omega
        subst hy
        intro z hz
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with hz | hz
        · omega
        · exact hle z hz

theorem bubbleSortAux_spec (n : Nat) :
    ∀ l : List Int, l.length ≤ n →
      List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (bubbleSortAux n l) ∧ (bubbleSortAux n l).Perm l := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l hl
    have : l = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (Nat.le_zero.mp hl)
    subst this
    simp [bubbleSortAux]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l hl
    rw [bubbleSortAux]
    split
    · rename_i h
      have hnil := passMin_perm l
      rw [h] at hnil
      have : l = [] := List.nil_perm.mp hnil
      subst this
      simp
    · rename_i y t h
      have hp := passMin_perm l
      rw [h] at hp
      have hlen : t.length ≤ n := by
        have := hp.length_eq
        simp at this
        omega
      obtain ⟨ihs, ihp⟩ := ih t hlen
      refine ⟨?_, (ihp.cons y).trans hp⟩
      rw [List.sorted_cons]
      refine ⟨?_, ihs⟩
      intro b hb
      have hbt : b ∈ t := ihp.mem_iff.mp hb
      exact passMin_head_le l y t h b (hp.mem_iff.mp (List.mem_cons_of_mem y hbt))
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem bubble_sort_postcond_satisfied (v : List Int) (h_precond : bubble_sort_precond v) :
    bubble_sort_postcond v (bubble_sort v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  exact bubbleSortAux_spec v.length v (le_refl _)
  -- !benchmark @end proof

Verified — the file compiles with no errors (only unused-variable warnings from the given skeleton).

## Approach

**Implementation** (`auxcode`), standard O(N²) bubble sort:

- `passMin` — one bubble pass scanning from the right: recurse on the tail, then compare the head `x` with the head of the passed tail and swap if out of order. Each adjacent-pair comparison bubbles the smallest element to the front.
- `bubbleSortAux n l` — repeats passes; after each pass the head is settled and the recursion continues on the remainder. The `Nat` argument is a pass budget so termination is structural; `bubble_sort` instantiates it with `v.length`, which is always enough.

**Proof** (`lemma` + `proof`), three steps:

1. `passMin_perm` — a pass permutes the list (the swap case uses `List.Perm.swap`).
2. `passMin_head_le` — if `passMin l = y :: t'` then `y` is a lower bound of `l`, by induction on the two comparison branches.
3. `bubbleSortAux_spec` — induction on the budget: the permutation follows from (1) chained with the IH; sortedness follows from `List.sorted_cons`, with the head bound coming from (2) transported through the permutation. The budget stays sufficient because a permutation preserves length.

One tactic note worth recording: `cases h : passMin t` left the `match` in the goal unreduced, so the branch case analysis is done with `split` + `rename_i` instead, which resolves the match and supplies the discriminant equation.
